  SUBSYSTEM: SUSCEPTOR RF INDUCTION THERMAL CONTROL & PRECURSOR DCS/H2 MOLAR RATIO

  - Control Architecture:

      * Arrhenius-Diffusion Combined Growth Rate Observer
      * Graceful Degradation & Dynamic Decoupling under RF Reflected Power Limits
====================================================================================================
*)
VAR_INPUT
    bEnable                 : BOOL;     (* Master process enable permissive from MES/Cluster Tool [TRUE=Run] *)
    bEStop                  : BOOL;     (* SIL-3 Hardwired Emergency Stop Relay Chain [TRUE=Healthy/Closed] *)

    rPyrometerTemp_B        : REAL;     (* Pyrometer Channel B Multi-Wavelength Optical Sensor [deg C] *)
    rPyrometerTemp_C        : REAL;     (* Pyrometer Channel C Multi-Wavelength Optical Sensor [deg C] *)
    rChamberPressure        : REAL;     (* Capacitance Manometer Absolute Process Chamber Pressure [Torr] *)
    rDCS_FlowActual         : REAL;     (* Dichlorosilane (SiH2Cl2) Digital MFC Process Feedback [sccm] *)
    rCarrierH2_FlowActual   : REAL;     (* Ultra-Pure Carrier Hydrogen (H2) Digital MFC Process Feedback [sccm] *)
    rRF_ReflectedPower      : REAL;     (* 450 kHz RF Generator Directional Coupler Reflected Power [kW] *)

    rTargetSusceptorTemp    : REAL;     (* Recipe Commanded Susceptor Surface Temperature Setpoint [deg C] *)
    rTargetDCS_MolarRatio   : REAL;     (* Commanded Precursor Molar Dilution Ratio DCS/(H2+DCS) * 100 [%] *)
END_VAR

VAR_OUTPUT
    bSystemReady            : BOOL;     (* All interlocks clear, pyrometers validated, thermal loop ready *)
    bDepositionActive       : BOOL;     (* Epitaxy chemical vapor deposition in active steady-state regime *)
    rRF_PowerSetpoint       : REAL;     (* RF Induction Generator Primary Active Power Command [kW] *)
    rDCS_FlowSetpoint       : REAL;     (* Dichlorosilane Mass Flow Controller Flow Rate Command [sccm] *)
    rCarrierH2_Setpoint     : REAL;     (* Purified Carrier Gas Hydrogen MFC Flow Rate Command [sccm] *)
    rEstGrowthRate          : REAL;     (* Real-time Arrhenius/Diffusion Hybrid Estimated Growth Rate [nm/min] *)
    rVotedSusceptorTemp     : REAL;     (* TMR 2oo3 Multi-Channel Validated Consensus Temperature [deg C] *)
    rCalcDCS_MolarRatio     : REAL;     (* On-line Computed DCS Precursor Molar Fraction in Carrier Gas [%] *)
    wAlarmWord1             : WORD;     (* Critical Tripping Fault Register [Bit 0: EStop, Bit 1: Overtemp...] *)
    wWarningWord2           : WORD;     (* Diagnostic and Advisory Warning Register [Bit 0: Pyrometer Drift...] *)
    iStateCurrent           : INT;      (* Active Finite State Machine Operational Sequence Step Number *)
END_VAR

VAR
    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANCY (TMR) TEMPERATURE VOTING ENGINE
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    bChA_Valid              : BOOL := TRUE;
    bChB_Valid              : BOOL := TRUE;
    bChC_Valid              : BOOL := TRUE;
    rDiff_AB                : REAL;
    rDiff_BC                : REAL;
    rDiff_CA                : REAL;
    rTempVoteBuffer         : REAL;
    iValidSensors           : INT := 3;
    rMaxDiscrepancyLimit    : REAL := 12.5;     (* Maximum allowable deviation before voting exclusion [deg C] *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       DISCRETE COUPLED THERMAL-CHEMICAL STATE-SPACE MODEL & MPC MATRICES
       State Vector x = [ Delta_T_susceptor [deg C], Delta_DCS_Ratio [%] ]^T
       Input Vector u = [ Delta_RF_Power [kW], Delta_DCS_Flow [sccm] ]^T
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    (* Discrete State Transition Matrix A (Ts = 100ms) *)
    A_11                    : REAL := 0.9852;   (* Susceptor radiative/conductive thermal decay pole *)
    A_12                    : REAL := -0.0142;  (* Endothermic chemical pyrolysis cooling coupling *)
    A_21                    : REAL := 0.0003;   (* Thermal expansion / gas residence acceleration effect *)
    A_22                    : REAL := 0.9120;   (* Precursor residence and chamber flush eigenvalue *)

    (* Discrete Control Input Matrix B *)
    B_11                    : REAL := 0.0485;   (* RF induction magnetic flux joule heating gain *)
    B_12                    : REAL := -0.0018;  (* Cold reactant gas injection enthalpy sink *)
    B_21                    : REAL := 0.0000;   (* RF power on molar concentration decoupling *)
    B_22                    : REAL := 0.0165;   (* Direct DCS mass injection dilution gradient *)

    (* Discrete Output Measurement Matrix C *)
    C_11                    : REAL := 1.0000;
    C_12                    : REAL := 0.0000;
    C_21                    : REAL := 0.0000;
    C_22                    : REAL := 1.0000;

    (* Model States & Kalman Observer Estimator States *)
    x_hat_1                 : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filtered Susceptor Temp Deviation Estimate [deg C] *)
    x_hat_2                 : REAL := 0.0;      (* Filtered DCS Molar Ratio Deviation Estimate [%] *)
    x_pred_1                : REAL := 0.0;
    x_pred_2                : REAL := 0.0;

    (* Kalman Observer Innovation Correction Gains *)
    L_11                    : REAL := 0.1850;
    L_12                    : REAL := 0.0012;
    L_21                    : REAL := 0.0005;
    L_22                    : REAL := 0.2240;

    (* MPC Quadratic Objective Cost Weights: J = x^T Q x + u^T R u + Delta_u^T S Delta_u *)
    Q_11                    : REAL := 4.5000;   (* Severe penalty on Susceptor temperature variance *)
    Q_22                    : REAL := 12.000;   (* Critical penalty on DCS/H2 molar stoichiometry drift *)
    R_11                    : REAL := 0.0800;   (* RF power actuation effort damping *)
    R_22                    : REAL := 0.0400;   (* DCS mass flow throttle effort damping *)

    (* Hessian Matrix Diagonal Approximations (H = B^T Q B + R) *)
    H_11                    : REAL := 0.09057;  (* Precomputed Hessian element 1,1 *)
    H_22                    : REAL := 0.04327;  (* Precomputed Hessian element 2,2 *)
    
    (* MPC Gradient and Optimal Unconstrained Step Vectors *)
    rGrad_1                 : REAL;
    rGrad_2                 : REAL;
    rOptStep_1              : REAL;
    rOptStep_2              : REAL;

    (* Actuation Baseline Operating Points (Linearization Origin) *)
    rRF_Power_Base          : REAL := 42.0;     (* Nominal 450 kHz RF Generator Baseline Output [kW] *)
    rDCS_Flow_Base          : REAL := 250.0;    (* Nominal Precursor Dichlorosilane Baseline [sccm] *)
    rH2_Flow_Base           : REAL := 30000.0;  (* Baseline Pure Carrier Gas Flow [sccm] *)

    (* Actuator Slew Rate Limiters & Bounds *)
    rRF_Power_DeltaMax      : REAL := 1.25;     (* Maximum permissible RF slew rate [kW/s] *)
    rDCS_Flow_DeltaMax      : REAL := 15.0;     (* Maximum permissible DCS MFC slew rate [sccm/s] *)
    rRF_MaxSafePower        : REAL := 95.0;     (* Thermal safety ceiling for induction coil [kW] *)
    rRF_MinSafePower        : REAL := 0.0;      (* Lower actuator clamp [kW] *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       EPITAXIAL GROWTH RATE OBSERVER (SURFACE KINETIC + MASS TRANSPORT)
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    rEa_over_R              : REAL := 18500.0;  (* Kinetic activation temperature Ea/R [Kelvin] *)
    rK_kinetic_0            : REAL := 4.25E7;   (* Surface kinetic pre-exponential factor *)
    rDiff_Coeff_0           : REAL := 2.85;     (* Fickian mass-transport boundary diffusion factor *)
    rTempKelvin             : REAL;
    rRate_Kinetic           : REAL;             (* Chemical surface reaction rate limit [nm/min] *)
    rRate_Diffusion         : REAL;             (* Boundary-layer gas phase transport limit [nm/min] *)

    (* -------------------------------------------------------------------------
       STATE MACHINE TIMERS & SEQUENCE MONITORING
       ------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
    tonBakeTimer            : TON;              (* High-temperature H2 clean bake dwell timer *)
    tonStabTimer            : TON;              (* Pre-deposition thermal stabilization timer *)
    tonDepTimer             : TON;              (* Epitaxial deposition target thickness timer *)
    tonPurgeTimer           : TON;              (* Post-deposition hydrogen purge sweep timer *)
    tStepTime               : TIME;
    iStatePrevious          : INT := 0;
    
    (* Physical Limits for Alarm Matrix *)
    c_rMaxSafeTemp          : REAL := 1220.0;   (* Graphite susceptor SiC sublimation ceiling [deg C] *)
    c_rMaxChamberPress      : REAL := 120.0;    (* High pressure limit for reduced-pressure epitaxy [Torr] *)
    c_rMaxReflectedRF       : REAL := 8.5;      (* Maximum allowable reflected RF before match shutdown [kW] *)
    c_rMaxSafeMolarRatio    : REAL := 3.5;      (* Gas-phase spontaneous homogeneous nucleation risk [%] *)
END_VAR

(*
====================================================================================================
  STAGE 01: SIL-3 HARDWIRED SAFETY PERMISSIVE & IMMEDIATE SHUTDOWN AUDIT
====================================================================================================
*)
IF (NOT bEStop) THEN
    (* Immediate Actuator Dump: De-energize RF Induction Field, Seal Toxic Gas Inlets *)
    rRF_PowerSetpoint   := 0.0;
    rDCS_FlowSetpoint   := 0.0;
    rCarrierH2_Setpoint := 45000.0;             (* Blast inert/H2 purge for dilution purge *)
    bSystemReady        := FALSE;
    bDepositionActive   := FALSE;
    wAlarmWord1.0       := TRUE;                (* Alarm Bit 0: Emergency Safety Interlock Tripped *)
    iStateCurrent       := 99;                  (* Jump to Emergency Abort Fail-Safe Mode *)
    RETURN;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord1.0       := FALSE;
END_IF;

IF (NOT bEnable) THEN
    rRF_PowerSetpoint   := 0.0;
    rDCS_FlowSetpoint   := 0.0;
    rCarrierH2_Setpoint := 5000.0;              (* Idling purge velocity *)
    bSystemReady        := FALSE;
    bDepositionActive   := FALSE;
    iStateCurrent       := 0;                   (* Idle Standby *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  STAGE 02: 2oo3 TRIPLE MODULAR REDUNDANT (TMR) TEMPERATURE SENSOR VOTING LOGIC
  Implements multi-channel optical pyrometer integrity assessment with online outlier rejection.
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Calculate pairwise pyrometer discrepancies *)
rDiff_AB := ABS(rPyrometerTemp_A - rPyrometerTemp_B);
rDiff_BC := ABS(rPyrometerTemp_B - rPyrometerTemp_C);
rDiff_CA := ABS(rPyrometerTemp_C - rPyrometerTemp_A);

(* Channel sanity boundaries: Silicon epitaxy valid window [600.0 .. 1300.0 deg C] *)
bChA_Valid := (rPyrometerTemp_A >= 600.0) AND (rPyrometerTemp_A <= 1300.0);
bChB_Valid := (rPyrometerTemp_B >= 600.0) AND (rPyrometerTemp_B <= 1300.0);
bChC_Valid := (rPyrometerTemp_C >= 600.0) AND (rPyrometerTemp_C <= 1300.0);

(* Count validated telemetry streams *)
iValidSensors := 0;
IF bChA_Valid THEN iValidSensors := iValidSensors + 1; END_IF;
IF bChB_Valid THEN iValidSensors := iValidSensors + 1; END_IF;
IF bChC_Valid THEN iValidSensors := iValidSensors + 1; END_IF;

IF (iValidSensors = 3) THEN
    (* Full TMR Mode: Check pairwise deviations *)
    IF (rDiff_AB <= rMaxDiscrepancyLimit) AND (rDiff_BC <= rMaxDiscrepancyLimit) AND (rDiff_CA <= rMaxDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
        (* Pristine consensus: Median selection for maximum noise rejection *)
        IF ((rPyrometerTemp_A >= rPyrometerTemp_B) AND (rPyrometerTemp_A <= rPyrometerTemp_C)) OR 
           ((rPyrometerTemp_A <= rPyrometerTemp_B) AND (rPyrometerTemp_A >= rPyrometerTemp_C)) THEN
            rVotedSusceptorTemp := rPyrometerTemp_A;
        ELSIF ((rPyrometerTemp_B >= rPyrometerTemp_A) AND (rPyrometerTemp_B <= rPyrometerTemp_C)) OR 
              ((rPyrometerTemp_B <= rPyrometerTemp_A) AND (rPyrometerTemp_B >= rPyrometerTemp_C)) THEN
            rVotedSusceptorTemp := rPyrometerTemp_B;
        ELSE
            rVotedSusceptorTemp := rPyrometerTemp_C;
        END_IF;
        wWarningWord2.0 := FALSE;               (* No sensor deviation warning *)
    ELSE
        (* One sensor is drifting: Detect and isolate the divergent channel *)
        wWarningWord2.0 := TRUE;                (* Warning Bit 0: Pyrometer Drift Detected *)
        IF (rDiff_AB > rMaxDiscrepancyLimit) AND (rDiff_CA > rMaxDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
            (* Channel A is the divergent outlier *)
            rVotedSusceptorTemp := (rPyrometerTemp_B + rPyrometerTemp_C) * 0.5;
            wWarningWord2.1 := TRUE;            (* Channel A Excluded *)
        ELSIF (rDiff_AB > rMaxDiscrepancyLimit) AND (rDiff_BC > rMaxDiscrepancyLimit) THEN
            (* Channel B is the divergent outlier *)
            rVotedSusceptorTemp := (rPyrometerTemp_A + rPyrometerTemp_C) * 0.5;
            wWarningWord2.2 := TRUE;            (* Channel B Excluded *)
        ELSE
            (* Channel C is the divergent outlier *)
            rVotedSusceptorTemp := (rPyrometerTemp_A + rPyrometerTemp_B) * 0.5;
            wWarningWord2.3 := TRUE;            (* Channel C Excluded *)
        END_IF;
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord1.3 := FALSE;                     (* TMR quorum healthy *)

ELSIF (iValidSensors = 2) THEN
    (* Graceful Degradation: 2oo2 Dual-channel averaging *)
    wWarningWord2.4 := TRUE;                    (* Degradation flag active *)
    IF (bChA_Valid AND bChB_Valid) THEN
        rVotedSusceptorTemp := (rPyrometerTemp_A + rPyrometerTemp_B) * 0.5;
    ELSIF (bChB_Valid AND bChC_Valid) THEN
        rVotedSusceptorTemp := (rPyrometerTemp_B + rPyrometerTemp_C) * 0.5;
    ELSE
        rVotedSusceptorTemp := (rPyrometerTemp_A + rPyrometerTemp_C) * 0.5;
    END_IF;
    wAlarmWord1.3 := FALSE;

ELSE
    (* Critical TMR Quorum Loss: Less than 2 pyrometers operational *)
    wAlarmWord1.3       := TRUE;                (* Alarm Bit 3: Fatal Pyrometer Quorum Loss *)
    rRF_PowerSetpoint   := 0.0;                 (* Cannot safely apply RF power without thermal observability *)
    rDCS_FlowSetpoint   := 0.0;
    iStateCurrent       := 99;                  (* Emergency Fail-Safe Abort *)
    RETURN;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  STAGE 03: PHYSICO-CHEMICAL ONLINE OBSERVERS & PRECURSOR MOLAR FRACTION DYNAMICS
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Absolute temperature conversion [Kelvin] *)
rTempKelvin := rVotedSusceptorTemp + 273.15;

(* Real-time DCS precursor molar fraction calculation *)
IF ((rCarrierH2_FlowActual + rDCS_FlowActual) > 10.0) THEN
    rCalcDCS_MolarRatio := (rDCS_FlowActual / (rCarrierH2_FlowActual + rDCS_FlowActual)) * 100.0;
ELSE
    rCalcDCS_MolarRatio := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Silicon Epitaxial Deposition Rate Hybrid Model:
   1. Kinetic Regime (Low Temp < 1000 C): Arrhenius thermal dissociation
   2. Mass-Transport Regime (High Temp > 1050 C): Gas phase diffusion resistance *)
IF (rTempKelvin > 800.0) THEN
    (* Surface Heterogeneous Kinetic Rate: R_kin = k0 * exp(-Ea / RT) * P_DCS *)
    rRate_Kinetic := (rK_kinetic_0 * EXP(-rEa_over_R / rTempKelvin)) * (rCalcDCS_MolarRatio * 0.01) * (rChamberPressure / 760.0);
    
    (* Gas-Phase Diffusion Boundary Layer Rate: R_diff = D0 * (T/T0)^1.75 * (P_DCS / P_tot) *)
    rRate_Diffusion := (rDiff_Coeff_0 * EXPT((rTempKelvin / 1273.15), 1.75)) * (rCalcDCS_MolarRatio * 0.01) * 350.0;

    (* Total Combined Growth Rate: 1 / R_tot = 1 / R_kin + 1 / R_diff *)
    IF ((rRate_Kinetic > 0.001) AND (rRate_Diffusion > 0.001)) THEN
        rEstGrowthRate := (rRate_Kinetic * rRate_Diffusion) / (rRate_Kinetic + rRate_Diffusion);
    ELSE
        rEstGrowthRate := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rEstGrowthRate := 0.0;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  STAGE 04: REAL-TIME COMPREHENSIVE ALARM & ANOMALY EVALUATION MATRIX
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Susceptor Over-temperature Interlock: Prevent graphite susceptor fracture & SiC delamination *)
IF (rVotedSusceptorTemp > c_rMaxSafeTemp) THEN
    wAlarmWord1.1 := TRUE;
    iStateCurrent := 99;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord1.1 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* RF Induction Generator Reflected Power Spike: Protect vacuum quartz bell-jar & coil arcing *)
IF (rRF_ReflectedPower > c_rMaxReflectedRF) THEN
    wAlarmWord1.2 := TRUE;                      (* Alarm Bit 2: RF Auto-Match Arc / Reflected Power *)
    (* Instantaneous RF power throttling to 50% to prevent destructive plasma strike *)
    rRF_Power_Base := rRF_Power_Base * 0.50;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord1.2 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Chamber Pressure High Barrier: Low-pressure silicon epitaxy typically runs at 10-80 Torr *)
IF (rChamberPressure > c_rMaxChamberPress) THEN
    wAlarmWord1.4 := TRUE;                      (* Alarm Bit 4: Chamber Over-pressure *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord1.4 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Precursor DCS Molar Fraction High Limit: Prevents gas phase silicon homogeneous dusting *)
IF (rCalcDCS_MolarRatio > c_rMaxSafeMolarRatio) THEN
    wAlarmWord1.5 := TRUE;                      (* Alarm Bit 5: DCS Molar Ratio Exceeded *)
    rDCS_FlowSetpoint := 0.0;                   (* Clamp toxic precursor to zero *)
ELSE
    wAlarmWord1.5 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Carrier H2 Starvation Barrier: Maintain dilution and laminar boundary profile *)
IF (rCarrierH2_FlowActual < 8000.0) AND (iStateCurrent >= 20) THEN
    wAlarmWord1.6 := TRUE;                      (* Alarm Bit 6: Carrier Gas Starvation *)
    iStateCurrent := 99;
ELSE
    wAlarmWord1.6 := FALSE;
END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  STAGE 05: KALMAN STATE OBSERVER & MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) OPTIMIZER
====================================================================================================
*)
(* Observer Innovation: Compare actual sensor feedback with previous state estimates *)
x_pred_1 := (A_11 * x_hat_1) + (A_12 * x_hat_2) + (B_11 * (rRF_PowerSetpoint - rRF_Power_Base)) + (B_12 * (rDCS_FlowSetpoint - rDCS_Flow_Base));
x_pred_2 := (A_21 * x_hat_1) + (A_22 * x_hat_2) + (B_21 * (rRF_PowerSetpoint - rRF_Power_Base)) + (B_22 * (rDCS_FlowSetpoint - rDCS_Flow_Base));

(* Measurement Update: Output residuals y - C * x_pred *)
x_hat_1 := x_pred_1 + L_11 * ((rVotedSusceptorTemp - rTargetSusceptorTemp) - x_pred_1) + L_12 * ((rCalcDCS_MolarRatio - rTargetDCS_MolarRatio) - x_pred_2);
x_hat_2 := x_pred_2 + L_21 * ((rVotedSusceptorTemp - rTargetSusceptorTemp) - x_pred_1) + L_22 * ((rCalcDCS_MolarRatio - rTargetDCS_MolarRatio) - x_pred_2);

(* MPC Quadratic Cost Gradient Evaluation: g = B^T * Q * x_hat *)
rGrad_1 := (B_11 * Q_11 * x_hat_1) + (B_21 * Q_22 * x_hat_2);
rGrad_2 := (B_12 * Q_11 * x_hat_1) + (B_22 * Q_22 * x_hat_2);

(* Newton-Raphson Quadratic Programming Step: Delta_u = - inv(Hessian) * Gradient *)
IF (H_11 > 0.0001) AND (H_22 > 0.0001) THEN
    rOptStep_1 := - (rGrad_1 / H_11);
    rOptStep_2 := - (rGrad_2 / H_22);
ELSE
    rOptStep_1 := 0.0;
    rOptStep_2 := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp actuation slew rates to prevent thermal shock and mass flow turbulence *)
IF (rOptStep_1 > rRF_Power_DeltaMax) THEN rOptStep_1 := rRF_Power_DeltaMax; END_IF;
IF (rOptStep_1 < -rRF_Power_DeltaMax) THEN rOptStep_1 := -rRF_Power_DeltaMax; END_IF;

IF (rOptStep_2 > rDCS_Flow_DeltaMax) THEN rOptStep_2 := rDCS_Flow_DeltaMax; END_IF;
IF (rOptStep_2 < -rDCS_Flow_DeltaMax) THEN rOptStep_2 := -rDCS_Flow_DeltaMax; END_IF;

(*
====================================================================================================
  STAGE 06: MULTI-PHASE 300mm EPITAXY RECIPE EXECUTION FINITE STATE MACHINE
====================================================================================================
*)
CASE iStateCurrent OF

    0: (* STATE 0: IDLE / STANDBY PURGE *)
        bSystemReady        := TRUE;
        bDepositionActive   := FALSE;
        rRF_PowerSetpoint   := 0.0;
        rDCS_FlowSetpoint   := 0.0;
        rCarrierH2_Setpoint := 5000.0;
        
        IF (bEnable AND (wAlarmWord1 = 16#0000)) THEN
            iStateCurrent := 10;                (* Initiate Chamber Prep *)
        END_IF;

    10: (* STATE 10: VACUUM LOAD LOCK & PURGE STABILIZATION *)
        bSystemReady        := FALSE;
        bDepositionActive   := FALSE;
        rRF_PowerSetpoint   := 0.0;
        rDCS_FlowSetpoint   := 0.0;
        rCarrierH2_Setpoint := 25000.0;         (* High-velocity H2 flush to displace trace O2/H2O *)
        
        tonPurgeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#20S);
        IF tonPurgeTimer.Q THEN
            tonPurgeTimer(IN := FALSE);
            iStateCurrent := 20;                (* Advance to Native Oxide Etch Bake *)
        END_IF;

    20: (* STATE 20: HIGH TEMPERATURE HYDROGEN BAKE (Native Oxide Thermal Desorption) *)
        (* Silicon native oxide SiO2 decomposes at 1180-1200 deg C under ultra-dry H2 reducing atmosphere *)
        bDepositionActive   := FALSE;
        rDCS_FlowSetpoint   := 0.0;
        rCarrierH2_Setpoint := 35000.0;
        
        (* Controlled RF power ramp to reach 1180 deg C bake temperature *)
        IF (rVotedSusceptorTemp < 1180.0) THEN
            rRF_PowerSetpoint := rRF_PowerSetpoint + 0.15;
            IF (rRF_PowerSetpoint > 75.0) THEN rRF_PowerSetpoint := 75.0; END_IF;
        ELSE
            (* Temperature reached: hold for bake duration *)
            tonBakeTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#60S);
            IF tonBakeTimer.Q THEN
                tonBakeTimer(IN := FALSE);
                iStateCurrent := 30;            (* Advance to Deposition Temperature Stabilization *)
            END_IF;
        END_IF;

    30: (* STATE 30: THERMAL STABILIZATION (Ramp to Target Deposition Temperature) *)
        bDepositionActive   := FALSE;
        rDCS_FlowSetpoint   := 0.0;
        rCarrierH2_Setpoint := 30000.0;
        
        (* Closed-loop thermal ramp toward recipe setpoint e.g. 1080 deg C *)
        IF (ABS(rVotedSusceptorTemp - rTargetSusceptorTemp) <= 2.0) THEN
            tonStabTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#15S);
            IF tonStabTimer.Q THEN

            rRF_PowerSetpoint := rRF_Power_Base + (rTargetSusceptorTemp - rVotedSusceptorTemp) * 0.12;

    40: (* STATE 40: PRECURSOR MASS FLOW FILL & BOUNDARY LAYER ESTABLISHMENT *)
        bDepositionActive   := FALSE;

        IF (rDCS_FlowSetpoint < rDCS_Flow_Base) THEN

        ELSE
            rDCS_FlowSetpoint := rDCS_Flow_Base;

        END_IF;

        IF (rRF_PowerSetpoint > rRF_MaxSafePower) THEN rRF_PowerSetpoint := rRF_MaxSafePower; END_IF;

        tonDepTimer(IN := TRUE, PT := T#120S);

        END_IF;

    60: (* STATE 60: POST-DEPOSITION RESIDUAL FLUSH & THERMAL RAMP-DOWN *)
        bDepositionActive   := FALSE;

        IF (bEStop AND (wAlarmWord1 = 16#0000)) THEN

        END_IF;
